multi_entity_note: Two parties in different roles: Chase Bank USA, N.A. and the Affiliate (plus LinkShare as network manager).
processing_note: Chase will evaluate your registration form and will notify you via e-mail of the acceptance or rejection of your registration form.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading names it the Chase Affiliate Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: A click-through form with no signing date; "Last Updated: April 6, 2007" is a revision date and 8/10/2007 is the filing source date.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The term starts on the date Chase approves the registration form, which is not stated as a date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement runs until terminated by either party; no expiry date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 23: governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: No renewal provision; the term is indefinite.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No renewal and no non-renewal notice period.
